subject: history
concept: Understanding historiography at a basic level: how historians' interpretations of the same event can differ and change over time
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's multi-perspective principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches two different historical interpretations of the same event to the evidence or perspective each relies on
exercise.abstract: Student explains why historians might interpret the same historical event differently

misconception_flags: believes there is only ever one single 'correct' historical interpretation of any event

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
